messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alerts: SLO breach detected for us-east-1 inference cluster. p95 spike and streaming stalls observed. Auto-escalation to on-call.
oncall-amber: acked. looking at dashboards now — can someone pull p95/p99 numbers and streaming stall rate? @sre-lee? :eyes:
sre-lee: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> 420ms in last ~6m. p99 ~2.3s. streaming stall rate ~28% (streams that stalled for >500ms). Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/inference/us-east-1/latency
oncall-amber: thx. any correlating infra events? pages? disk IO? runtime-chandra you changed cache prefs yesterday right?
runtime-chandra: I rolled a prefetch tuning to reduce prefill aggressiveness (rollout id: prefetch-2026-03-14T22). It reduced background prefetch but also changed the prefill/decoder handshake timeout. Noticed a small increase in prefill misses in canary but didn't cross alert thresholds.
eng-evict: looking at KV cache metrics — eviction_rate jumped to 3.4k/s on several shards ~6m ago. Active slab utilization shows fragmentation up ~18%. Also seeing decode_queue length spike for tail tokens.
sre-lee: sounds like cache pressure + frag => more cold decodes and imbalanced prefill vs decode (prefill lagging decode). That produces streaming tail stalls when decoder waits for KV prefill.
oncall-amber: can you paste the key metrics? small snippets ok.
sre-lee: paste: ```
kv_eviction_rate: 3400/s
kv_prefill_rate: 900/s
kv_decode_rate: 2100/s
prefill_hit_ratio: 0.37
streaming_stall_pct: 28
p95: 420ms
p99: 2.3s
``` 
runtime-chandra: those numbers show prefill << decode; decode is outrunning prefill by ~1.2k/s. likely cause: a recent change to prefetch dispatcher that lowered concurrency per shard.
eng-evict: I can temporarily raise prefetch worker count and increase slab reclaim threshold to reduce eviction churn. Suggest immediate mitigation: bump prefill concurrency and enable aggressive coalesced prefetch for hot prefixes.
oncall-amber: do it. eng-evict, run the quick config patch and restart prefetch workers on a subset of shards (canary first). Keep changes minimal.
eng-evict: running quick patch now. command: ```
$ curl -XPOST https://infra-api/internal/configs/prefetch -d '{"prefetch_workers": 12, "coalesce_window_ms": 8}'
$ kubectl rollout restart deploy/prefetch-worker -n inference --selector=region=us-east-1 --timeout=60s
``` will monitor.
(oncall-amber adds reaction :thumbsup:)
incident-bot: Deploy webhook: prefetch-config update started by eng-evict. Canary rollouts 3 pods.
eng-evict: canary pods back up. prefill_rate rising to ~1.6k/s on canary shards within 45s.
sre-lee: nice. eviction_rate dropped to ~1.9k/s on those shards and streaming stall for impacted prefix dropped from 28% -> 9% in canary.
oncall-amber: roll to 50% shard set, keep monitoring p99 esp for streaming sessions.
eng-evict: rolling to 50%... done.
runtime-chandra: quick note — we saw an odd allocation: one slab class on shard-7 had high internal fragmentation; I bumped freelist compaction for that slab which reduced local eviction pressure.
oncall-amber: good. what's customer impact? cust-success-sam, can you draft a short status note we can push if this persists?
cust-success-sam: sure — draft: "We observed increased latency and streaming interruptions in us-east-1 affecting a subset of streaming calls. Engineers are mitigating; there may be temporary elevated tail latency. No data loss. We'll update in 30m or when resolved." Want me to post to status.redwood.ai after you confirm.
oncall-leo: I'm taking handoff in 20m (nadir watch). oncall-amber — summarize next steps and any followups for me.
oncall-amber: summary for handoff -> 1) rolling prefetch config applied (prefetch_workers:12, coalesce_window_ms:8) 2) monitor p95/p99 and streaming_stall_pct for next 30m 3) watch kv_eviction_rate and per-shard fragmentation (if eviction_rate > 2k/s revert/adjust) 4) if stalls reappear, route new incoming traffic to fallback_lower_mem model variant to cut mem pressure: route rule "low-memory-fallback" ready. 5) ticket for infra to run slab defrag in maintenance window (ticket: INF-4421)
oncall-leo: ack. I will keep an eye and escalate to SRE rotation if >15min regression. Also will coordinate with eng-evict to run a targeted defrag tonight.
sre-lee: follow-up: we should add a metric alert for prefill/decoder imbalance (kv_prefill_rate/kv_decode_rate ratio < 0.6) — creating an alert now.
sre-lee: alert created: INFR-ALERT-prefill-decoder-imbalance (notify: eng-sre, eng-runtime)
oncall-amber: posting to #status in 5 with cust-success drafted message. also logging timeline in incident doc: https://governance/internal/incidents/6481357901
cust-success-sam: posted status page and notified top 5 customers via DM. one customer replied with increased error logs, forwarding to support.
oncall-leo: taking over. will ping if anything flares. ETA check-in 20m.
incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied; status: monitoring. next update scheduled in 20m.
oncall-amber: closing direct paging for now — if anything spikes, page SRE primary. leaving channel to oncall-leo. :wave:
